title: Website Security Billing Rules for New Harborline SiteGuard Plans
content:
**Billing clause.** A Website Security plan is billed the tier's 12-month term price for a 12-month term or its 1-month term price for a 1-month term. When the hosting plan the site runs on, as recorded on the security plan, names a Harborline hosting plan that is active, the term price is reduced by the product's hosted-site discount percentage, and when the website security discount percentage of the customer's account tier under Harborline Customer Accounts is higher, that single percentage applies instead; the two never add. A tier that is withheld from sites with included scanning (on the Harborline SiteGuard tiers, Harborline SiteGuard Essentials) may be ordered only for a site whose Harborline hosting plan tier does not include daily malware scanning, as the tier of that plan under Web Hosting Plans states. Amounts are rounded half up to the cent, and a plan is billed when ordered, while it is pending setup.

## The discount percentage

The percentage taken off the term price is the higher of:

- the product's hosted-site discount percentage, counted only for a site on an active Harborline hosting plan; and
- the website security discount percentage of the customer's Harborline account tier.

Only one percentage is applied. The two are never added together.

## The amount billed

The amount billed for the first term is the term price for the chosen term multiplied by one hundred less the discount percentage, divided by one hundred, and rounded half up to the cent. The term prices and the hosted-site discount percentage are the product figures of each Harborline SiteGuard tier.

## What the order records

The order date is the term start date and the plan's opening date; the term end date is the order date plus the term in calendar months; the plan starts with its initial auto-renew setting and in status pending setup. The first term is billed on the order as one charge, paid by card, PayPal or account credit. The net amount billed for a plan is its purchase, renewal, upgrade and extra cleanup charges, less its refunds.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, not company prices or rates)

| Hypothetical case | Percentage applied | Amount billed |
|---|---|---|
| Term price 77.77; site on an active Harborline hosting plan; hosted-site discount 12 percent; account tier discount 30 percent | 30 percent, the higher one | 77.77 multiplied by 70 and divided by 100 is 54.439, rounded half up to 54.44 |
| Term price 77.77; site on an active Harborline hosting plan; hosted-site discount 12 percent; account tier discount 0 percent | 12 percent | 77.77 multiplied by 88 and divided by 100 is 68.4376, rounded half up to 68.44 |
| Term price 77.77; site hosted elsewhere; account tier discount 30 percent | 30 percent, the account tier's percentage being the higher of the two | 54.44 |
| Term price 77.77; site hosted elsewhere; account tier discount 0 percent | No percentage | 77.77 |
